'''Sellers''': {{legend0|#e27f7f|50–60%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Richard Shelby]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Richard Shelby]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }} {{Elections in Alabama sidebar}} The '''1992 United States Senate election in Alabama''' took place on November 3, 1992, alongside other elections to the [[United States Senate]] in other states as well as elections to the [[United States House of Representatives]] and various state and local elections. Incumbent Senator [[Richard Shelby]] won re-election to a second term in a landslide, winning every county except [[Shelby County, Alabama|Shelby]]. This was the last time a Democrat was elected to the U.S. Senate in Alabama until [[Doug Jones (politician)|Doug Jones]] won a [[2017 United States Senate special election in Alabama|2017 special election]]. As to date, this remains the last time a Democrat has won the Class 3 Senate seat in Alabama and won a full term as a senator; Shelby switched parties in 1994 and continued to serve as a Republican
